title: NIST Center for Neutron Research
content:
Aerogel National Laboratory. The NIST Center for Neutron Research (NCNR) in Gaithersburg, Maryland, operates a 20 MW research reactor and is one of the world's leading neutron-scattering user facilities. It provides beam time to academic, industrial, and government researchers through a peer-reviewed proposal system.

NCNR instruments support small-angle neutron scattering, diffraction, spectroscopy, and imaging, which are powerful probes of pore structure, molecular dynamics, and hydrogen content in materials. These methods are directly relevant to studying aerogels and other porous materials, including network structure, adsorption behavior, and thermal transport mechanisms.
